pages.name: Dwelling Info (Risk Schedule)
pages.caption: DwellingPage / RiskSchedule
pages.purpose: Capture dwelling physical characteristics: form, year built, construction, roof, wind mitigation parameters, fire protection, BCEG

fields.label: Usage
fields.validation: Options: Primary, Secondary, Seasonal(3-6), Seasonal(>6), FarmRanch, UnderConstruction, Rental(HO6 only)

fields.label: # of Months Unoccupied
fields.visCondition: UseType NOT IN Secondary, Seasonal3to6, Seasonal6Mths

fields.label: Structure
fields.validation: Options: Apartment(HO4), Condo(HO6), Dwelling, Rowhouse, Townhouse, Modular/Prefab

fields.label: Construction
fields.validation: Options: Frame, Aluminum, PlasticSiding, Masonry, MasonryVeneer, Superior

fields.label: Protection Class
fields.calc: DwellingPrivate.CalcProtectionClass from Geocode; SplitPPC logic; Suburban 88 logic

fields.label: # of Units in Fire Division
fields.calc: Used in WindMitigation building type calc

fields.label: Number of Stories
fields.calc: Used in WindMitigation building type calc

fields.label: Supplemental Heat Type
fields.validation: Options: FireplaceInsert, Electric, Gas, Other, Unknown

fields.label: Opening Protection
fields.validation: Options: ClassA, ClassB, ClassC, None, Unknown
fields.calc: Drives WindMitigation factor; validation rules on hurricane ded combos

fields.label: Roof Type
fields.validation: Options: Architectural, Asphalt, Builtup, Concrete, Fiberglass, Metal, Other, Slate, TileBarrelTile, TileFlatTile, Wood
fields.calc: Drives RoofAge → RoofSurfacesFactor; UW age rules

fields.label: Sprinkler System
fields.validation: Options: None, SinglePoint, WholeHome, Shutoff, ClassB=Full, ClassA=Partial

fields.label: Plumbing Pipe Material
fields.validation: Options: PVCCPVC, PEPEX, Copper, Polybutylene, GalvanizedSteel, Other

fields.label: Roof Shape
fields.validation: Options: Hip, Gable, Flat, Other, NA; masonry/HO6→must=NA

fields.label: Secondary Water Resistance
fields.validation: Options: Yes, No, Unknown; SWR=No AND RoofDeck=Reinforce → validation error

fields.label: Roof to Wall Attachment
fields.validation: Options: ToeNails, Clips, SingleWraps, DoubleWraps, Unknown, NA; complex validation vs RoofDeckAttachment, YearBuilt

fields.label: Terrain
fields.validation: Options: B, C, H, Unknown; Terrain=C→various UW rules on OpeningProtection, WindSpeedLocation

fields.label: Wind Speed Location
fields.validation: Options: 100, 110, 120+, 120WBDR, Unknown; complex validation with WindSpeedDesign combos

fields.label: Roof Deck Attachment
fields.validation: Options: A6d@612, B8d@612, C8d@66, WoodDeck, MetalDeck, Reinforce, NA; complex UW validation rules

fields.label: Hurricane Deductible
fields.validation: N=Excluded, $500, 2%, 5%, 10%; 30+ cross-field UW validations with CovA/C limits

dependencies.result: EffectiveYear - YearBuilt → HouseTypeFactor, roof UW rules

dependencies.condition: 30+ rules with form, CovA/C limits, year built

pages.name: Dwelling Coverage
pages.caption: DwellingCoverage
pages.purpose: Set all coverage limits, deductibles, and optional endorsements for the dwelling policy
pages.inheritance: LOB (Coverage objects defined in Marketplace base; FL-specific overrides by PersonalHome Peril)

fields.label: Dwelling Limit (A)
fields.calc: Drives: CovB included, CovC included, CovD included, Hurricane ded dollar calcs, MSB comparison

fields.label: Other Structures Limit (B)
fields.calc: IncludedLimit=CovA×factor; extra premium on amount above included

fields.label: Medical Payments Limit (F)
fields.validation: Options: 0=No Coverage (validRef=UseTypeIsNotPrimary), 3000, 5000; if CovE=0→F=0; if CovE≠0 AND F=0→F=3000

fields.label: Hurricane Deductible
fields.calc: % dollar calcs for CovA or CovC

fields.label: Replacement Cost – Dwelling
fields.validation: misc: forced False if form not HO2/HO3

fields.label: Replacement Cost Value
fields.validation: Maximum: 1,000,000; if=0 AND CovA>0→set to CovA

fields.label: Water Back Up and Sump Overflow
Carports, Pool Cages & Screen Enclosures
fields.validation: Max: CarportsPoolCagesPrivate.MaximumLimit; if >0 AND <10000→set to 10000; UW: limit ≤ $75,000 (message 62)

fields.label: Water Backup of Sewers or Drains
Personal Injury
fields.validation: misc: if CovE Limit=0 → forced False; Limit: $5,000 (readOnly)

fields.label: Unit-Owners Rental to Others
fields.validation: misc: forced False if not HO6

fields.label: Coverage Tier / Package
fields.calc: onChange → sets defaults for all coverage limits via CoverageDefaults table

fields.label: Coverage A Premium (display)
fields.calc: CovA BaseRate × FormFactor × ProtConstrFactor × KeyFactor × RateAdjustmentFactor

dependencies.result: CoverageDefaults table lookups set all limits
CovA only active for dwelling forms
